title: Unique extension of natural additive actions through sheafification
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J, with set-valued sheafification in a fixed universe. Let G be an abelian group sheaf and P a presheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], whose sheafification unit is locally injective and locally surjective. A sectionwise operation a of G on P, natural under restriction and satisfying zero and addition, extends uniquely to an operation b on the sheafification of P with the same laws and naturality, such that b(g,eta(p))=eta(a(g,p)) for every object, group section and presheaf section.

source.place: Tag 00WH, associated sheaf; local bijectivity and sheaf gluing; torsor application as in Tag 03AH of sites-cohomology.tex

proof.text: Local injectivity of eta and separatedness of P-sharp show that eta(a(g,p)) depends only on eta(p). Restrict to the covering equalizer sieve of p and q and use naturality of a.

On the covering image sieve of x, choose representatives p of restrictions of x and translate by restrictions of g. Independence proves compatibility. Glue in P-sharp, and use separatedness on pullback covering sieves to prove the characterization for every local representative.
Uniqueness of the characterized section gives naturality and the zero and addition laws. Every operation with naturality and the unit formula has the same characterization, proving uniqueness.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by local representatives, covering sieves and sheaf gluing.

theorem existsUnique_sheafify_add_action
    (a : ∀ U, G.obj.obj U → P.obj U → P.obj U)
    (hz : ∀ U t, a U 0 t = t)
    (ha : ∀ U g h t, a U (g + h) t = a U g (a U h t))
    (hn : ∀ ⦃U V⦄ (f : U ⟶ V) g t,
      P.map f (a U g t) = a V (G.obj.map f g) (P.map f t)) :
    ∃! b : ∀ U, G.obj.obj U → (sheafify J P).obj U → (sheafify J P).obj U,
      (∀ U t, b U 0 t = t) ∧
      (∀ U g h t, b U (g + h) t = b U g (b U h t)) ∧
      (∀ ⦃U V⦄ (f : U ⟶ V) g t,
        (sheafify J P).map f (b U g t) =
          b V (G.obj.map f g) ((sheafify J P).map f t)) ∧
      (∀ U g t, b U g ((toSheafify J P).app U t) =
        (toSheafify J P).app U (a U g t))
